items.title: FIELD REPORT
items.text:
FIELD REPORT
We've found PEARL lab in Lake Baikal!
PEARL
Scientists are here, isolated by Utopia. They have samples of a cure–we need to get it to JADE. Utopia patrols are everywhere–we will have to move cautiously. It's too dangerous to carry it in the open. We need to inject a massive dose of the sample in ourselves–carry it in our bodies.
A dose that large will certainly kill the carrier.
We have exactly 4 doses. Once they're gone, they're gone.
Open the following doors:
Q  38  27  32

rules: Discover the PEARL lab in Lake Baikal.
There are exactly 4 doses. Once they're gone, they're gone.
A dose that large will certainly kill the carrier.
mechanics.effect: Pearl is in Lake Baikal and holds cure samples that must reach Jade. The team will carry exactly 4 doses in their bodies, and a dose kills the carrier. This door's only component is the report. The dose cards are not in this folder.

summary: Pearl field report from Lake Baikal. Exactly 4 doses exist, each one kills its carrier, and the samples have to reach Jade. Open doors Q, 38, 27, and 32. No dose cards are in this door.
